transferModal.promoteQuestion: Promote this academy rider to your senior squad:
transferModal.promoteNote: They take a senior place and a senior contract. Their academy salary is replaced by the senior wage shown above.
transferModal.promoteNoteKeepsContract: They take a senior place. Their current contract and wage carry over unchanged.
transferModal.demoteNote: They free a senior place and stop counting toward your senior squad. They are pulled from any upcoming races they were entered in.
transferModal.demoteNoteOngoing: They free a senior place and stop counting toward your senior squad. They are pulled from any upcoming races they were entered in. Youth squad riders aren't race-eligible, so they will also drop out of the race currently underway shown above.
transferModal.demoteNoteKeepsContract: They free a senior place and stop counting toward your senior squad. They are pulled from any upcoming races they were entered in. Their contract follows them down unchanged: same wage, same length.
transferModal.demoteNoteKeepsContractOngoing: They free a senior place and stop counting toward your senior squad. They are pulled from any upcoming races they were entered in. Youth squad riders aren't race-eligible, so they will also drop out of the race currently underway shown above. Their contract follows them down unchanged: same wage, same length.
